units.source_text: 古歌：“啼声纺作长长线，欲把泪珠粒粒穿。”

en.t: An old poem says: "I would spin the crying voice into a long thread, and string each tear like a bead upon it."
It appears in the Kokin waka rokujo.

units.source_text: 作者是伊势守藤原继荫之女，是宇多天皇的皇后藤原温子的宫女，得天皇宠爱。

en.t: The author was the daughter of Fujiwara no Tsugukage, governor of Ise; she served as a lady-in-waiting to Fujiwara no Onshi, consort of Emperor Uda, and won the emperor's favor.

units.source_text: 善作诗歌，为三十六歌仙之一。

en.t: She was skilled at composing poetry and became one of the Thirty-six Immortal Poets.
